name: airbnb-mern
description: Airbnb clone - MERN: backend (API), frontend (guests/hosts), admin (panel)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run server" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
